description: This file contains UI component functions for rendering agent status panels, including agent context, channels, cron jobs, and file management, using lit-html templates and external libraries for markdown rendering and sanitization.

methods.name: renderAgentContextCard
methods.description: Renders a UI card displaying agent context details such as workspace, model, identity, skills, and default status.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves the display label for a channel based on its metadata or label mapping.

methods.name: resolveChannelEntries
methods.description: Generates an ordered list of channel entries with labels and accounts from the snapshot.

methods.name: summarizeChannelAccounts
methods.description: Summarizes account statuses for a list of channel accounts, including counts of connected, configured, and enabled accounts.

methods.name: renderAgentChannels
methods.description: Renders the UI for agent channels, including status, refresh button, and channel details.

methods.name: renderAgentCron
methods.description: Renders the UI for agent cron jobs, including scheduling status, jobs list, and control buttons.

methods.name: renderAgentFiles
methods.description: Renders the UI for managing agent workspace files, including file list, editing, preview, and save/reset actions.
